en.steps:
You select your health concern from a list | Log in with electronic ID and follow the relevant pathway based on your symptoms.
You answer standardized questions from a doctor | The questionnaires are tailored in collaboration with Icelandic specialist doctors for each issue — the process is designed like a consultation with a doctor. When a home test improves diagnostic assessment, you will be guided to take one, such as a urine test available from primary care or your nearest pharmacy, and enter the result directly into the portal.
Red flags assessed in combination with your answers | Red flags in the questionnaires immediately direct serious symptoms to the right service. Fjarlækningar does not handle concerns that belong elsewhere — and you do not pay if you are redirected.
A doctor reviews and recommends treatment | A doctor reviews your answers and recommends appropriate treatment based on their medical assessment. No treatment without a doctor’s assessment.
Outcome, advice, and prescription | You receive a written outcome and advice, and if needed, a prescription is sent electronically to the medication portal — ready at your nearest pharmacy. The outcome also includes educational material related to your concern: advice, preventive guidance, and over-the-counter products that may help.
en.faq1_a:
Medical services from Fjarlækningar doctors are available through the Fjarlækningar website, wherever it suits you. There, you can access treatment options for defined, common conditions. With Fjarlækningar, you get a more convenient way to see a doctor, with a medical assessment — and a prescription if appropriate — within 2 hours every day between 10:00–22:00.

You go through a process where you answer a doctor’s standard questions about yourself and your health. Once you have completed the questions, you pay the same fee as a visit to primary care, and your case is sent to a doctor. A Fjarlækningar doctor provides a tailored treatment plan, and your outcome appears in the patient portal, where you can access treatment options and messages from the doctor. If the diagnosis indicates that you need a prescription medicine, a prescription will also be sent to the medication portal, where it can be redeemed at your nearest pharmacy.
en.faq1_q: How does the medical service work?
en.faq2_a:
Fjarlækningar provides medical services for the following conditions:

· Cold, cough and sore throat | Simple respiratory infections, sore throat, frontal and sinus infections
· Urinary tract and vaginal infections | Urinary tract infections in women, vaginal yeast infections and bacterial vaginosis
· Erectile dysfunction
· Cold sores (not initial diagnosis)
· Shingles of the skin (not initial diagnosis)
· Pinworms | Treatment for the whole family
· Pollen allergy
· Prescription renewals | The service allows you to renew medicines that you use regularly. Not all medicines can be renewed through this service — you will be informed during the process which medicines cannot be renewed.
· Medical certificates | Sick notes for employers and schools. This service is only available to those who need an absence certificate related to a condition that has been handled through the telemedicine service.
en.faq2_q: Which medical conditions does Fjarlækningar handle?
en.faq3_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are comparable to a primary care visit, and you only pay the standard visit fee of ISK 1,000 per case, just as in primary care. Fees for sick notes follow the primary care fee schedule.
en.faq3_q: How much do Fjarlækningar medical services cost?
en.faq4_a: The medical service is available to people aged 18 and over who have electronic ID. More information on where the service is available can be found here: https://www.fjarlaekningar.is/thjonusta
en.faq5_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are available through the Fjarlækningar website by clicking “patient portal” and through the HSU website: https://island.is/s/hsu
en.faq5_q: How can I use the medical service?
en.faq6_a:
Fjarlækningar medical services guide you through standard questions based on validated medical methods that collect detailed information about you, your history and your health, which a doctor then uses for diagnosis. The entire process is developed in collaboration with specialist physicians.

By answering a doctor’s standard questions, you provide the information the doctor needs to make decisions about diagnosis and treatment for your specific condition. Medical pathways ensure standardized procedures, and education and guidance are an important part of Fjarlækningar treatment options. All decisions about diagnosis and treatment are made by the doctor handling your case.

All processing of personal data meets the strictest security requirements of the Directorate of Health and is also in line with European laws on the processing of sensitive data, using a certified electronic health record system.
en.faq6_q: Is the service a safe solution for medical issues?
en.faq7_a:
Many conditions are such that a doctor does not necessarily need to examine you in person to provide treatment. Detailed questions about how you are feeling and your medical history allow the doctor to diagnose the issue and suggest treatment. Fjarlækningar handles such conditions in a simple and convenient way. There are, however, some cases that require further testing to assess the condition more thoroughly and improve diagnostic accuracy, such as CRP, streptococcal testing and urine testing. Fjarlækningar handles such cases by using self-tests that you can collect from your health centre or nearest pharmacy.

Some conditions require an in-person examination by a doctor for safe diagnosis and treatment. If your answers indicate that you need a medical examination, Fjarlækningar will not handle your case but will guide you to the right care pathway.
en.faq7_q: Isn’t a medical examination needed to get treatment?
en.faq8_a: To ensure your safety and the security of your information, electronic identification is required. This allows doctors to confirm who is requesting the service.
en.faq8_q: What if I do not have electronic ID?
en.faq9_a: You can check whether your SIM card supports electronic ID. If you have the right type of SIM card, you can visit the nearest electronic ID registration point with a valid driver’s licence (not digital), passport or Icelandic identity card and have electronic ID issued to your phone.
en.faq9_q: How do I get electronic ID?
en.faq10_a:
All processing of personal data meets the strictest security requirements of the Directorate of Health and is also in line with European laws on the processing of sensitive data. Fjarlækningar uses a secure and certified electronic health record system where information is stored in accordance with laws on health information.

All processing of personal and health information at Fjarlækningar meets strict security and privacy requirements under Icelandic law and European data protection legislation (GDPR). Fjarlækningar uses a secure and certified electronic health record system in which health information is stored and processed in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
en.faq11_a:
Prescriptions can be renewed for medicines that you take regularly. Please note that some treatments require regular follow-up, for example blood pressure medicines, heart medicines, and medicines for anxiety and depression. This service does not replace regular follow-up with your GP, but it is a convenient option if you need a quick prescription renewal. You will receive the prescription in the medication portal once the doctor has completed the review. The prescription can be redeemed at any pharmacy.

Please note that only a standard prescription can be issued, i.e. not a repeat prescription. For the renewal of certain medicines, it is necessary to speak to the doctor who previously prescribed them for you. These medicines may, for example, be classified as addictive, stimulant, or psychiatric medicines.

en.faq12_a: If Fjarlækningar doctors cannot resolve your case, you will be referred to the appropriate service, for example primary care, Læknavakt or another healthcare institution.
en.faq12_q: What if my issue cannot be resolved?
en.faq13_a: If your answers or medical history indicate that the safest option is an examination by a doctor, you will receive information and advice to help you with the next steps. If we do not have a solution for you, you pay nothing for the service. The service is not for people who believe they are in immediate danger. In all service areas, we ask detailed questions about serious symptoms and medical history to assess whether a serious illness may be involved.
en.faq13_q: When can I not get an assessment and treatment from a doctor?
en.faq14_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are digital only. If your condition does not improve or gets worse, you can always go through the questionnaire again or seek an in-person medical examination. If you do not agree with the doctor’s assessment, you can click “Send inquiry” in the Fjarlækningar patient portal.
en.faq14_q: What if I want to see the doctor in person?
en.faq15_a: If your condition does not improve or gets worse, you can submit a new case to Fjarlækningar or contact primary care or another healthcare institution for further assessment. If you disagree with the doctor’s assessment or have questions or concerns about it, you can click “Send inquiry” in the Fjarlækningar patient portal.
en.faq15_q: What if I am unhappy with the doctor’s assessment?
en.faq16_a: The solution is neither AI nor a chatbot. The medical service guides you through standard questions that provide detailed information about you, your history and your health, which a doctor then uses for diagnosis. The entire process is developed by Fjarlækningar specialist physicians. All outcomes are advised by a doctor, including both treatment options and general guidance related to your condition.
en.faq16_q: Is it AI responding to me or a person?
en.faq17_a: Correct medical advice and treatment safety are of the utmost importance to us, and it is the medical assessment of Fjarlæknar that children under 18 should always be seen by a doctor in person. Fjarlækningar is therefore only for people aged 18 and over.
en.faq17_q: Why can’t I answer on behalf of my child?
en.faq18_a: The service offering is assessed based on risk and the scope of diagnosis. The conditions we handle are simple and clearly defined and generally do not require a doctor’s examination. We are continuously working to expand our service offering.
en.faq18_q: Why are there not more services or other conditions?
en.faq19_a: The aim of the service and Fjarlækningar procedures is to ensure standardized practices based on medical pathways. The benefit is a more accurate assessment that clearly indicates whether a condition requires antibiotics or not. Standardized pathways and procedures are in fact more likely to help prevent antibiotic overuse. Antibiotic overuse is unfortunately a known problem in Icelandic society as well as abroad, but the goal of Fjarlækningar is to promote safe prescribing and medicine use.
en.faq19_q: Does the service increase the risk of antibiotic overuse?
en.faq20_a:
The service has been developed with Icelandic specialist physicians and also in close dialogue with companies providing similar telehealth services in the Nordic countries. The medical pathways that Fjarlækningar is responsible for are in place to prevent overtreatment and unnecessary treatment of patients. We work purposefully on patient education and guidance because we believe that information and education about your own health and health-related issues are the key to better decision-making — which is why good education and guidance are part of Fjarlækningar treatment options.

By answering standardized and important questions from a doctor, you provide the doctor with the information needed to make decisions about diagnosis and treatment. All processes are based on medical principles with the aim of providing the most accurate assessment and treatment possible.
en.faq20_q: Is there an increased risk of overtreatment?
en.faq21_a: You can use the service again if your symptoms change or if you have a new issue. By using the service, you confirm that all questions are answered honestly and to the best of your ability. The doctor has an overview of your medical history, and you may be contacted by phone if your answers are unclear.
en.faq21_q: Can I go through the process more than once?
en.faq22_a: If your answers indicate that the safest option is an examination by a doctor, you will receive information and advice to help you with the next steps. If we do not have a solution for you, you do not pay for the service.
en.faq22_q: Will I always get a solution to my issue?
en.faq23_a: At first, the service is only available in the form of standardized questions from Fjarlækningar doctors and diagnosis of defined, common conditions.
en.faq23_q: Is it possible to have a video consultation with a doctor?
en.faq24_a: If you have a serious illness, we always advise an in-person examination by a doctor. Fjarlækningar is not for people who believe they are in immediate danger. In all service areas, detailed questions are asked about serious symptoms and medical history that could indicate serious illness. If so, Fjarlækningar will advise you on where best to seek care.
en.faq24_q: What if I am in danger?
en.cta_body: Log in to the patient portal and choose your case. Simple, secure, and most cases are handled within two hours during opening hours.
en.how_body: The entire process is developed in collaboration with specialist physicians and doctors with decades of experience in primary care. The questionnaires reflect the questions a doctor would ask a patient, but the key difference is that you can answer them from anywhere. A doctor then reviews your answers and determines the next steps based on their medical assessment.
en.hero_body: Fjarlækningar handles common issues that can be resolved without an in-person examination by a doctor. This makes the path to care simpler and safer, while reducing waiting times for medical services.
en.live_body: We launch the service in partnership with healthcare institutions, one health centre at a time. Healthcare Institution of South Iceland (HSU) is the first institution to offer the service.
en.meds_note: Please note that this list is not exhaustive.
en.cta_footer: During the pilot project, the service is only available to patients registered with HSU.

is.steps:
Þú velur erindi af vandamálalista | Skráðu þig inn með rafrænum skilríkjum og farðu í viðeigandi ferli eftir einkennum.
Þú svarar stöðluðum spurningum læknis | Spurningalistar eru sérhannaðir í samstarfi við íslenska sérfræðilækna tengt hverju vandamáli — ferlið er hannað eins og viðtal við lækni. Þegar heimapróf bætir greiningu er þér leiðbeint að taka það, t.d. þvagpróf sem sækja má á heilsugæslu eða í næsta apóteki, og skrá niðurstöðuna beint í gáttina.
Rauð flögg könnuð | Rauð flögg (alvarleg einkenni) eru yfirfarin og þá er hægt að vísa því strax í réttan farveg innan heilbrigðiskerfisins.
Læknir metur og leggur til meðferð | Læknir fer yfir öll svörin og leggur til viðeigandi meðferð út frá sínu læknisfræðilega mati.
Niðurstaða, ráðleggingar og lyfseðill | Þú færð skriflega niðurstöðu og ráðleggingar, og lyfseðill fer rafrænt í lyfjagátt ef þörf er á, tilbúinn í næsta apóteki. Niðurstöðunni fylgir fræðsluefni tengt þínu vandamáli: ráðleggingar, fyrirbyggjandi ráð og vörur án lyfseðils sem geta hjálpað.
is.how_body: Allt ferlið er unnið í samstarfi við sérfræðilækna og lækna með víðtæka reynslu á heilsugæslu. Spurningar sem skjólstæðingar fá spegla þær spurningar sem læknir myndi spyrja sjúkling að en stóri munurinn er sá að hægt er að svara þessum spurningum hvar sem er. Læknir yfirfer og metur svo næstu skref út frá sínu læknisfræðilega mati.
is.hero_body: Fjarlækningar leysa algeng vandamál sem hægt er að leysa án skoðunar hjá lækni. Þannig er hægt að einfalda leiðina til læknis með öruggum hætti og stytta biðina eftir læknisþjónustu.
is.live_body: Við opnum þjónustuna í samstarfi við heilbrigðisstofnanir, eina heilsugæslu í einu. Heilbrigðisstofnun Suðurlands er fyrsta stofnunin sem opnar fyrir þjónustuna.
is.meta_title: Læknir á netinu — lyfseðill og mat læknis
is.test2_when: Þvagfæra- og leggangasýkingar - þvagfærasýking í fyrsta skipti
is.test3_when: Kvef, hósti og hálsbólga - hálsbólga, til að aðstoða greiningu
is.tests_body: Fyrir sum erindi bætir einfalt sjálfspróf matið á erindinu. Spurningarnar frá læknum Fjarlækninga gefa það í ljóst hvort heimapróf þurfi, en þetta á ekki við um öll erindi. Þú sækir sjálfsprófið sjálf/sjálfur, tekur það þar sem hentar og skráir niðurstöðuna inn.
is.limits_body: Fjarlækningar leysa einföld og afmörkuð erindi. Sum erindi þarfnast skoðunar, rannsóknar eða bráðaþjónustu og þeim er þá vísað í annan farveg.
is.hero_heading: Styttri leið til læknis með ==Fjarlækningum== í samstarfi við ==Heilbrigðisstofnun Suðurlands==
is.limits4_body: Ef sjúkrasaga sýnir alvarlega undirliggjandi sjúkdóma getur verið of áhættusamt að afgreiða erindið í gegnum fjarþjónustu - þá er vísað í hefðbundna þjónustu.
is.tests_footer: Ef þú hefur einhverjar spurningar er þér velkomið að hafa samband við okkur í tölvupósti á fjarlaekningar@fjarlaekningar.is.
is.tests_s1_desc: Þú velur erindi og svarar stöðluðum spurningum sem tekur nokkrar mínútur. Eigi sjálfspróf við um þitt erindi færðu skilaboð um hvaða próf það er, en á ekki við um öll erindi.
is.tests_s2_desc: Þú getur sótt sjálfsprófið á þína heilsugæslu eða í apóteki - sjá hvar hentar best hér að ofan. Leiðbeiningar um hvernig það er tekið fylgir með í pakkanum og í sjúklingagáttinni.
is.tests_accuracy: Þegar sjálfspróf bætir greiningu er þér leiðbeint að taka það, en niðurstaðan eykur greiningarnákvæmni. Prófið kemur þó ekki í stað mats læknis: læknir fer yfir niðurstöðuna ásamt svörunum þínum úr spurningalistanum. Sé niðurstaðan óljós, eða passi einkennin ekki við hana, er erindinu vísað í hefðbundna þjónustu.
is.tests_s1_title: Spurningar gefa í ljós hvort þurfi sjálfspróf
is.tests_s2_title: Þú sækir sjálfsprófið - klárar þar sem hentar
is.tests_why_body: Fyrir afmörkuð og algeng erindi getur einfalt próf, sem þú tekur sjálf eða sjálfur, gefið lækni þær upplýsingar sem upp á vantar til að ljúka matinu - án þess að þú þurfir að bóka tíma, ferðast og bíða. Þannig verður ferlið einfaldara og hraðara fyrir þig, og heilsugæslan getur einbeitt sér að flóknari erindum.

· Shingles of the skin (not initial diagnosis)
· Pinworms | Treatment for the whole family
· Pollen allergy
· Prescription renewals | The service allows you to renew medicines that you use regularly. Not all medicines can be renewed through this service — you will be informed during the process which medicines cannot be renewed.
· Medical certificates | Sick notes for employers and schools. This service is only available to those who need an absence certificate related to a condition that has been handled through the telemedicine service.
en.faq2_q: Which medical conditions does Fjarlækningar handle?
en.faq3_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are comparable to a primary care visit, and you only pay the standard visit fee of ISK 1,000 per case, just as in primary care. Fees for sick notes follow the primary care fee schedule.
en.faq3_q: How much do Fjarlækningar medical services cost?
en.faq4_a: The medical service is available to people aged 18 and over who have electronic ID. More information on where the service is available can be found here: https://www.fjarlaekningar.is/thjonusta
en.faq5_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are available through the Fjarlækningar website by clicking “patient portal” and through the HSU website: https://island.is/s/hsu
en.faq5_q: How can I use the medical service?
en.faq6_a:
Fjarlækningar medical services guide you through standard questions based on validated medical methods that collect detailed information about you, your history and your health, which a doctor then uses for diagnosis. The entire process is developed in collaboration with specialist physicians.

By answering a doctor’s standard questions, you provide the information the doctor needs to make decisions about diagnosis and treatment for your specific condition. Medical pathways ensure standardized procedures, and education and guidance are an important part of Fjarlækningar treatment options. All decisions about diagnosis and treatment are made by the doctor handling your case.

All processing of personal data meets the strictest security requirements of the Directorate of Health and is also in line with European laws on the processing of sensitive data, using a certified electronic health record system.
en.faq6_q: Is the service a safe solution for medical issues?
en.faq7_a:
Many conditions are such that a doctor does not necessarily need to examine you in person to provide treatment. Detailed questions about how you are feeling and your medical history allow the doctor to diagnose the issue and suggest treatment. Fjarlækningar handles such conditions in a simple and convenient way. There are, however, some cases that require further testing to assess the condition more thoroughly and improve diagnostic accuracy, such as CRP, streptococcal testing and urine testing. Fjarlækningar handles such cases by using self-tests that you can collect from your health centre or nearest pharmacy.

Some conditions require an in-person examination by a doctor for safe diagnosis and treatment. If your answers indicate that you need a medical examination, Fjarlækningar will not handle your case but will guide you to the right care pathway.
en.faq7_q: Isn’t a medical examination needed to get treatment?
en.faq8_a: To ensure your safety and the security of your information, electronic identification is required. This allows doctors to confirm who is requesting the service.
en.faq8_q: What if I do not have electronic ID?
en.faq9_a: You can check whether your SIM card supports electronic ID. If you have the right type of SIM card, you can visit the nearest electronic ID registration point with a valid driver’s licence (not digital), passport or Icelandic identity card and have electronic ID issued to your phone.
en.faq9_q: How do I get electronic ID?
en.faq10_a:
All processing of personal data meets the strictest security requirements of the Directorate of Health and is also in line with European laws on the processing of sensitive data. Fjarlækningar uses a secure and certified electronic health record system where information is stored in accordance with laws on health information.

All processing of personal and health information at Fjarlækningar meets strict security and privacy requirements under Icelandic law and European data protection legislation (GDPR). Fjarlækningar uses a secure and certified electronic health record system in which health information is stored and processed in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
en.faq11_a:
Prescriptions can be renewed for medicines that you take regularly. Please note that some treatments require regular follow-up, for example blood pressure medicines, heart medicines, and medicines for anxiety and depression. This service does not replace regular follow-up with your GP, but it is a convenient option if you need a quick prescription renewal. You will receive the prescription in the medication portal once the doctor has completed the review. The prescription can be redeemed at any pharmacy.

Please note that only a standard prescription can be issued, i.e. not a repeat prescription. For the renewal of certain medicines, it is necessary to speak to the doctor who previously prescribed them for you. These medicines may, for example, be classified as addictive, stimulant, or psychiatric medicines.

en.faq12_a: If Fjarlækningar doctors cannot resolve your case, you will be referred to the appropriate service, for example primary care, Læknavakt or another healthcare institution.
en.faq12_q: What if my issue cannot be resolved?
en.faq13_a: If your answers or medical history indicate that the safest option is an examination by a doctor, you will receive information and advice to help you with the next steps. If we do not have a solution for you, you pay nothing for the service. The service is not for people who believe they are in immediate danger. In all service areas, we ask detailed questions about serious symptoms and medical history to assess whether a serious illness may be involved.
en.faq13_q: When can I not get an assessment and treatment from a doctor?
en.faq14_a: Fjarlækningar medical services are digital only. If your condition does not improve or gets worse, you can always go through the questionnaire again or seek an in-person medical examination. If you do not agree with the doctor’s assessment, you can click “Send inquiry” in the Fjarlækningar patient portal.
en.faq14_q: What if I want to see the doctor in person?
en.faq15_a: If your condition does not improve or gets worse, you can submit a new case to Fjarlækningar or contact primary care or another healthcare institution for further assessment. If you disagree with the doctor’s assessment or have questions or concerns about it, you can click “Send inquiry” in the Fjarlækningar patient portal.
en.faq15_q: What if I am unhappy with the doctor’s assessment?
en.faq16_a: The solution is neither AI nor a chatbot. The medical service guides you through standard questions that provide detailed information about you, your history and your health, which a doctor then uses for diagnosis. The entire process is developed by Fjarlækningar specialist physicians. All outcomes are advised by a doctor, including both treatment options and general guidance related to your condition.
en.faq16_q: Is it AI responding to me or a person?
en.faq17_a: Correct medical advice and treatment safety are of the utmost importance to us, and it is the medical assessment of Fjarlæknar that children under 18 should always be seen by a doctor in person. Fjarlækningar is therefore only for people aged 18 and over.
en.faq17_q: Why can’t I answer on behalf of my child?
en.faq18_a: The service offering is assessed based on risk and the scope of diagnosis. The conditions we handle are simple and clearly defined and generally do not require a doctor’s examination. We are continuously working to expand our service offering.
en.faq18_q: Why are there not more services or other conditions?
en.faq19_a: The aim of the service and Fjarlækningar procedures is to ensure standardized practices based on medical pathways. The benefit is a more accurate assessment that clearly indicates whether a condition requires antibiotics or not. Standardized pathways and procedures are in fact more likely to help prevent antibiotic overuse. Antibiotic overuse is unfortunately a known problem in Icelandic society as well as abroad, but the goal of Fjarlækningar is to promote safe prescribing and medicine use.
en.faq19_q: Does the service increase the risk of antibiotic overuse?
en.faq20_a:
The service has been developed with Icelandic specialist physicians and also in close dialogue with companies providing similar telehealth services in the Nordic countries. The medical pathways that Fjarlækningar is responsible for are in place to prevent overtreatment and unnecessary treatment of patients. We work purposefully on patient education and guidance because we believe that information and education about your own health and health-related issues are the key to better decision-making — which is why good education and guidance are part of Fjarlækningar treatment options.

By answering standardized and important questions from a doctor, you provide the doctor with the information needed to make decisions about diagnosis and treatment. All processes are based on medical principles with the aim of providing the most accurate assessment and treatment possible.
en.faq20_q: Is there an increased risk of overtreatment?
en.faq21_a: You can use the service again if your symptoms change or if you have a new issue. By using the service, you confirm that all questions are answered honestly and to the best of your ability. The doctor has an overview of your medical history, and you may be contacted by phone if your answers are unclear.
en.faq21_q: Can I go through the process more than once?
en.faq22_a: If your answers indicate that the safest option is an examination by a doctor, you will receive information and advice to help you with the next steps. If we do not have a solution for you, you do not pay for the service.
en.faq22_q: Will I always get a solution to my issue?
en.faq23_a: At first, the service is only available in the form of standardized questions from Fjarlækningar doctors and diagnosis of defined, common conditions.
en.faq23_q: Is it possible to have a video consultation with a doctor?
en.faq24_a: If you have a serious illness, we always advise an in-person examination by a doctor. Fjarlækningar is not for people who believe they are in immediate danger. In all service areas, detailed questions are asked about serious symptoms and medical history that could indicate serious illness. If so, Fjarlækningar will advise you on where best to seek care.
en.faq24_q: What if I am in danger?
en.cta_body: Log in to the patient portal and choose your case. Simple, secure, and most cases are handled within two hours during opening hours.
en.how_body: The entire process is developed in collaboration with specialist physicians and doctors with decades of experience in primary care. The questionnaires reflect the questions a doctor would ask a patient, but the key difference is that you can answer them from anywhere. A doctor then reviews your answers and determines the next steps based on their medical assessment.
en.hero_body: Fjarlækningar handles common issues that can be resolved without an in-person examination by a doctor. This makes the path to care simpler and safer, while reducing waiting times for medical services.
en.live_body: We launch the service in partnership with healthcare institutions, one health centre at a time. Healthcare Institution of South Iceland (HSU) is the first institution to offer the service.
en.meds_note: Please note that this list is not exhaustive.
en.cta_footer: During the pilot project, the service is only available to patients registered with HSU.

is.steps:
Þú velur erindi af vandamálalista | Skráðu þig inn með rafrænum skilríkjum og farðu í viðeigandi ferli eftir einkennum.
Þú svarar stöðluðum spurningum læknis | Spurningalistar eru sérhannaðir í samstarfi við íslenska sérfræðilækna tengt hverju vandamáli — ferlið er hannað eins og viðtal við lækni. Þegar heimapróf bætir greiningu er þér leiðbeint að taka það, t.d. þvagpróf sem sækja má á heilsugæslu eða í næsta apóteki, og skrá niðurstöðuna beint í gáttina.
Rauð flögg könnuð | Rauð flögg (alvarleg einkenni) eru yfirfarin og þá er hægt að vísa því strax í réttan farveg innan heilbrigðiskerfisins.
Læknir metur og leggur til meðferð | Læknir fer yfir öll svörin og leggur til viðeigandi meðferð út frá sínu læknisfræðilega mati.
Niðurstaða, ráðleggingar og lyfseðill | Þú færð skriflega niðurstöðu og ráðleggingar, og lyfseðill fer rafrænt í lyfjagátt ef þörf er á, tilbúinn í næsta apóteki. Niðurstöðunni fylgir fræðsluefni tengt þínu vandamáli: ráðleggingar, fyrirbyggjandi ráð og vörur án lyfseðils sem geta hjálpað.
is.how_body: Allt ferlið er unnið í samstarfi við sérfræðilækna og lækna með víðtæka reynslu á heilsugæslu. Spurningar sem skjólstæðingar fá spegla þær spurningar sem læknir myndi spyrja sjúkling að en stóri munurinn er sá að hægt er að svara þessum spurningum hvar sem er. Læknir yfirfer og metur svo næstu skref út frá sínu læknisfræðilega mati.
is.hero_body: Fjarlækningar leysa algeng vandamál sem hægt er að leysa án skoðunar hjá lækni. Þannig er hægt að einfalda leiðina til læknis með öruggum hætti og stytta biðina eftir læknisþjónustu.
is.live_body: Við opnum þjónustuna í samstarfi við heilbrigðisstofnanir, eina heilsugæslu í einu. Heilbrigðisstofnun Suðurlands er fyrsta stofnunin sem opnar fyrir þjónustuna.
is.meta_title: Læknir á netinu — lyfseðill og mat læknis
is.test2_when: Þvagfæra- og leggangasýkingar - þvagfærasýking í fyrsta skipti
is.test3_when: Kvef, hósti og hálsbólga - hálsbólga, til að aðstoða greiningu
is.tests_body: Fyrir sum erindi bætir einfalt sjálfspróf matið á erindinu. Spurningarnar frá læknum Fjarlækninga gefa það í ljóst hvort heimapróf þurfi, en þetta á ekki við um öll erindi. Þú sækir sjálfsprófið sjálf/sjálfur, tekur það þar sem hentar og skráir niðurstöðuna inn.
is.limits_body: Fjarlækningar leysa einföld og afmörkuð erindi. Sum erindi þarfnast skoðunar, rannsóknar eða bráðaþjónustu og þeim er þá vísað í annan farveg.
is.hero_heading: Styttri leið til læknis með ==Fjarlækningum== í samstarfi við ==Heilbrigðisstofnun Suðurlands==
is.limits4_body: Ef sjúkrasaga sýnir alvarlega undirliggjandi sjúkdóma getur verið of áhættusamt að afgreiða erindið í gegnum fjarþjónustu - þá er vísað í hefðbundna þjónustu.
is.tests_footer: Ef þú hefur einhverjar spurningar er þér velkomið að hafa samband við okkur í tölvupósti á fjarlaekningar@fjarlaekningar.is.
is.tests_s1_desc: Þú velur erindi og svarar stöðluðum spurningum sem tekur nokkrar mínútur. Eigi sjálfspróf við um þitt erindi færðu skilaboð um hvaða próf það er, en á ekki við um öll erindi.
is.tests_s2_desc: Þú getur sótt sjálfsprófið á þína heilsugæslu eða í apóteki - sjá hvar hentar best hér að ofan. Leiðbeiningar um hvernig það er tekið fylgir með í pakkanum og í sjúklingagáttinni.
is.tests_accuracy: Þegar sjálfspróf bætir greiningu er þér leiðbeint að taka það, en niðurstaðan eykur greiningarnákvæmni. Prófið kemur þó ekki í stað mats læknis: læknir fer yfir niðurstöðuna ásamt svörunum þínum úr spurningalistanum. Sé niðurstaðan óljós, eða passi einkennin ekki við hana, er erindinu vísað í hefðbundna þjónustu.
is.tests_s1_title: Spurningar gefa í ljós hvort þurfi sjálfspróf
is.tests_s2_title: Þú sækir sjálfsprófið - klárar þar sem hentar
is.tests_why_body: Fyrir afmörkuð og algeng erindi getur einfalt próf, sem þú tekur sjálf eða sjálfur, gefið lækni þær upplýsingar sem upp á vantar til að ljúka matinu - án þess að þú þurfir að bóka tíma, ferðast og bíða. Þannig verður ferlið einfaldara og hraðara fyrir þig, og heilsugæslan getur einbeitt sér að flóknari erindum.
